events.text: Goal! Lens 0, Sporting Lisbon 1. Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nestory Irankunda with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Lens 0, Sporting Lisbon 1.
Second Half begins Lens 0, Sporting Lisbon 1.

Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Luís Guilherme replaces Geny Catamo.
Substitution, Lens. Michal Skóras replaces Saud Abdulhamid.
Substitution, Lens. Mezian Mesloub replaces Junior Kadile.
Michaël Cuisance (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Jesse Derry replaces Nestory Irankunda.

Goal! Lens 0, Sporting Lisbon 2. Issa Doumbia (Sporting Lisbon) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Silas Andersen with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Lens. Yacine Titraoui replaces Amadou Haidara.
